facts.fact: NIDA, the national authority, keeps the central register and runs registration of people through 153 district offices linked to its data centre.
NIDA says its in-house experts built 24 of 42 planned systems and provide technical support, ending dependence on foreign contractors.
NIDA says that by building its systems in-house it owns the actual program copies of the national ID system and is free of foreign contractors' licence limits.
